overall: The AG found the Ashby Selectboard violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently detailed April 13 minutes that did not summarize the Heywood Road drainage discussion, ordering future compliance and amended minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint says the April 13 minutes are too thin and fail to capture the roughly hour-long Heywood Road drainage discussion.
allegations.key_passage: This is insufficient to comply with the requirement to summarize the discussion that occurred.

allegations.summary: AG reviewed the April 13 minutes generally and found them insufficient where they list topics, motions and votes without summarizing any discussion.
Board's response to the August 7 complaint came September 15, outside the 14-business-day window; AG issued a reminder only, with no finding.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Amend the minutes of the April 13 meeting within 30 days of the letter date, in compliance with the guidance provided.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the law. Additionally, we order the Board to amend the minutes of its April 13 meeting, within 30 days of the date of this letter, in compliance with the guidance provided above.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
